verification.stopping_rule_replay: pass: constants confirmed from source and sidecar (tol_stable_count 90 from Options.update_defaults, 18 iterations, 14 of 17, improvement window 9, warp distance 6, entropy switch off); re-implemented rule matches the recorded stable flag in 20 of 20 runs; the recorded flag is set before the warp gate, so excluding the gate is required rather than a judgement; applied warps (transformer changed) reproduce every final termination; 33 of 40 flagged rotoscales were undone
verification.index_decomposition: pass: mean of rebuilt terms reproduces the stored index to at most 3.9e-5; implied HPD noise variance 9.0000, so the constant-noise substitution is exact
verification.spatial_statistics: record reproduced exactly, but the post-warmup split and initial-design rows were taken on live logger rows after warmup trimming (4-20 rows trimmed per run, 1-6 initial rows missing), moving the inside-50 count from 8 to 6 of 10 and the nearest-neighbour and deep-tail counts from 8 to 7 of 10; the moment-matched 50 and 99 percent ellipses hold 0.598 and 0.969 of the true banana mass
verification.selection_summary: pass: reproduced exactly for seeds 2008 and 2002; fallback totals 287 finite-difference and 4 row-budget of 1700; refinement gain diluted by zero-gain fallbacks
verification.budget_provenance: pass: max_fun_evals 200 from the benchmark contract's paper budget passed as a user option; the package default for a specified-noise run would be 300; other effective options are package defaults or the noisy adjustments
